chooseAWorkspacePatTheLocal: Choose a workspace PAT, the local glab CLI login, or an environment-provided token. CLI and environment credentials must already be available to the kandev backend.
chooseWhetherToIncludeOnlyDirect: Choose whether to include only direct reviewer requests or the broader compatible scope.
connectAGitlabAccountSoKandev: Connect a GitLab account so kandev can open merge requests, read review discussions, and reply to / resolve them on your behalf.
controlsTaskDeletionWhenTheGitlab: Controls task deletion when the GitLab item closes.
enableThisWatchBeforeCheckingNow: Enable this watch before checking now
enterAPersonalAccessTokenToSwitch: Enter a personal access token to switch to PAT.
enterAValidHttpOrHttpsGitlabHost: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS GitLab host URL.
everyQuickActionNeedsALabel: Every quick action needs a label and prompt.
gitlabHostUrlOverrideForSelf: GitLab host URL. Override for self-managed instances; leave at the default for {{host}}.
gitlabWatchCouldNotBeSaved: GitLab watch could not be saved
initialStepForEachNewTask: Initial step for each new task.
issueWatchDialogDescription: Automatically create workspace tasks for newly matching GitLab issues.
label: Label
leaveEmptyToMatchMergeRequests: Leave empty to match merge requests requesting your review. Adding parameters explicitly replaces that reviewer constraint.
optionalCapPollingResumesWhenActive: Optional cap; polling resumes when active tasks fall below it.
optionalCommaSeparatedGitlabLabelsThat: Optional comma-separated GitLab labels that matching issues must include.
optionalCommaSeparatedNamespaceProjectPa: Optional comma-separated namespace/project paths. Empty watches every accessible project.
optionalGitlabApiQueryParametersSuch: Optional GitLab API query parameters, such as {{example}}.
optionalOtherwiseUsesTheWorkflowStep: Optional; otherwise uses the workflow step default.
pollGitlabForMergeRequestsAwaiting: Poll GitLab for merge requests awaiting review and create one task per new match.
pollGitlabIssuesAndCreateOne: Poll GitLab issues and create one task per new match.
promptSentToTheSelectedAgent: Prompt sent to the selected agent profile for each new match.
reviewWatchDialogDescription: Automatically create workspace tasks for newly matching GitLab merge requests.
taskPromptsShownOnTheGitlab: Task prompts shown on the GitLab browse page for merge requests and issues.
thisWillDeleteEveryTaskCreated: This will delete every task created by this watch, including archived tasks, and remove its polling history. This cannot be undone.
yourTokenMayStillBeValid: Your token may still be valid — this looks like a network or upstream issue.
